anchors.ceiling_hook: origin on the ceiling hook (chandeliers, hanging lanterns hang down)
anchors.cell_block_centre: origin on the centre of the cell block at floor level (rooms, halls, ceilings, fields)
anchors.cell_centre: origin on one cell's centre at floor level (ground tiles, bridges, stairs, cells, water)
anchors.cell_corner: origin on a cell corner (towers; the castle gate block centred on a corner between two edges)
anchors.cell_edge: origin on a cell boundary line at floor level; the piece runs along X and faces its front (+Z)
anchors.door_anchor: origin on the room.gd door anchor: 0.4 m in from the room edge = 0.1 m behind the boundary
anchors.free: footprint-centred free prop (any position on the floor)
anchors.gate_anchor: origin on a gatehouse portcullis / drawbridge socket
anchors.lot_centre: origin on the centre of a building lot (lot_m in meta, door socket on the street side, +Z)
anchors.wall_face: origin on a wall's inner face at floor level (banners, shields, shelves, sconces, hearths)

connectors.rule: a room / building door socket takes exactly one vlg.doorway frame (room.gd places it from the room's door data via the arch.door binding)
edge pieces (town walls, fences, hedges, curtains, banks) meet end to end on cell corners; towers carry curtain wall_end sockets on four axes
sconce origin on the socket, facing the socket direction
closed <-> raised state pair on the gatehouse passage
lowered <-> raised state pair in front of the gate
closed <-> open gate leaves state pair
ground tiles meet on cell-edge midpoints; path width 2 m

grid.note: room plot = cells x 4 m + 0.5 m apron each side; door.position for side cell i = 4*i + 2
